source_policy: OpenFootball completed regular-season match ledgers for ENG/GER/ESP/FRA/POR/NED, with a source-verified official NAC Breda supplement for the completed 2025/26 NAC Breda-SC Heerenveen fixture; audit PASS required before freeze.
scope_policy: Foreign top-division raw domestic metrics only. Italy remains sourced from the separately audited private Serie A + Serie B match freeze.
metric_policy: Preserve points_per_game, goal_difference_per_game and tie-averaged within-league ppg_percentile. No manual league or recency weights.
mutability_policy: foreign v0 is immutable. If reacquisition changes JSON or CSV hashes, workflow fails and a new dataset version is required.
